comment: Function reference of the Help page (?p=help#ref-php / #ref-js), rendered by NuFnRef (core/nufnref.php). One entry per line: n name, s signature, g group, d description, r return, e example, p parameters {name: description}, x sample result (shown after the example), o origin (nb = nuBuilder Forte 4.9, next = nuBuilder Next only), v since, a also see (names, shown first), h a section of the Guide for Also see, k kind (missing = a function of the code: dev/tests/run.php checks that every function of the code has an entry and the other way round; method / hook = documented only). English only.

items.d: Runs an SQL statement. Parameters as ? placeholders or :names (array keys). Database errors stop the code with a message.
items.r: NuResult (for db_fetch_…), or the new id when $isInsert is true
items.e:
$t = nuRunQuery('SELECT cus_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id = ?', ['#RECORD_ID#']);
$r = db_fetch_object($t);
items.x:
Bluepeak Systems – London
Maple Ridge Supply – Toronto

p.$isInsert: true: return the id of the new row

items.d: Like nuRunQuery, but database errors are ignored (nuBuilder Forte: no debug entry).
items.e:
$t = nuRunQueryNoDebug('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maybe_missing_table');
nuDebug($t === '' ? 'table missing' : db_fetch_row($t)[0]);

p.$isInsert: true: return the id of the new row

items.d: Tries a query without logging anything.
items.r: true when it runs, otherwise the exception
items.e:
$ok = nuRunQueryTest('SELECT inv_total FROM invoice LIMIT 1');
nuDebug($ok === true ? 'ok' : $ok->getMessage());
